skills.title: Startle (Moro) reflex
skills.how_to_spot: Arms fling out at sudden sounds or movement, then pull back in.

skills.title: Rooting reflex
skills.how_to_spot: Turns toward a cheek stroke with an open mouth, hunting for food.

skills.title: Strong grasp reflex
skills.how_to_spot: Curls fingers tightly around yours when you touch the palm.

skills.title: Random arm & leg movements
skills.how_to_spot: Jerky, uncoordinated waving — the nervous system is wiring up.

skills.title: Focuses 8–12 inches away
skills.how_to_spot: Locks onto your face at feeding distance; farther is still blurry.

skills.title: Recognizes your voice and smell
skills.how_to_spot: Calms or stills to the voice heard from inside for months.

skills.title: Calms when held
skills.how_to_spot: Settles against a warm chest — contact is regulation at this age.

skills.title: Lifts head briefly in tummy time
skills.how_to_spot: A wobbly one-two seconds at first; the reps build neck strength.

skills.title: Turns head side to side lying down
skills.how_to_spot: Clears the airway and starts steering attention.

skills.title: Stretches arms, opens palms
skills.how_to_spot: Fists gradually relax; open hands appear more often.

skills.title: Reacts to loud sounds
skills.how_to_spot: Startles, blinks, stirs in sleep — hearing is on the job.

skills.title: Cries to communicate
skills.how_to_spot: Different needs slowly acquire slightly different cries.

skills.title: Makes throaty little sounds
skills.how_to_spot: Grunts and sighs — the warm-up band before cooing.

skills.title: Follows a face in a short arc
skills.how_to_spot: Tracks your slow movement from one side toward the middle.

skills.title: Hands find the mouth
skills.how_to_spot: Fist-sucking arrives — self-soothing, not necessarily hunger.

skills.title: Studies high-contrast patterns
skills.how_to_spot: Bold black-and-white shapes hold attention longest.

skills.title: Quiets to a familiar routine
skills.how_to_spot: The bath-feed-lullaby chain starts to signal what's next.

skills.title: Social smile
skills.how_to_spot: Smiles back at your face and voice — the first true conversation.

skills.title: Coos vowel sounds
skills.how_to_spot: 'Ooo' and 'aah' in calm, alert moments.

skills.title: Calms when spoken to or picked up
skills.how_to_spot: Your response reliably down-shifts the crying.

skills.title: Watches you as you move
skills.how_to_spot: Eyes follow you across short distances around the room.

skills.title: Holds head up in tummy time
skills.how_to_spot: Steadier lifts, chin well off the mat.

skills.title: Smoother arm and leg motion
skills.how_to_spot: Newborn jerkiness gives way to flowing movement.

skills.title: Turn-taking sounds
skills.how_to_spot: Coos, pauses when you talk, then 'answers' again.

skills.title: Brings hands together
skills.how_to_spot: Midline discovery — hands meet, clasp and inspect each other.

skills.title: Bats and swipes at objects
skills.how_to_spot: Aims at dangling toys; contact is the victory.

skills.title: Briefly holds a toy
skills.how_to_spot: Keeps a light rattle in the grip for a few seconds.

skills.title: Pushes up on forearms
skills.how_to_spot: Mini push-ups raise the chest in tummy time.

skills.title: Steadier head held upright
skills.how_to_spot: Less wobble when carried or held sitting.

skills.title: Squeals and gurgles
skills.how_to_spot: Volume experiments — the voice is a new toy.

skills.title: Turns toward interesting sounds
skills.how_to_spot: Rotates head to find a rattle or your voice off to the side.

skills.title: Faster smiles for familiar faces
skills.how_to_spot: Known people get instant warmth; strangers get study.
